title: Target level and target date what-if controls (G-22-1)
reference_behaviour: A NIFTY Target slider with a numeric box and a Date slider with arrow stepping, each with Reset; projected P&L, the breakeven at the target date and a projected-P&L badge recompute at once.
ours: REQ-034 AC-6 target level and date inputs (ADR-151) are not built; the controls only switch At Expiry / Estimated Now and set a range.
